name: media-framing
description: Foundations contract for the media FRAMING classes _media.scss actually styles: media--border, media--circle, media--cover, and the iframe aspect-ratio classes. Deliberately narrow: shared/media.ts emits a larger class family (media--small/medium/large/widescreen/square/no-crop/date), but those are styled ONLY inside .card scope (card.scss) and belong to Card's future contract — claiming them here would violate one-contract-per-token when Card migrates. Two unrelated systems share the 'media' name: this file's framing classes (consumed via shared/media.ts by Card and Callout) vs components/media/Media.vue, the embed-type switcher (image/video/iframe/vertical_video/remote_video) whose contract is DEFERRED to the Banner family migration because its video behavior is coupled to Banner (assets/js/video.js hardcodes '.banner video' and only Banner.vue instantiates UidsVideo).

figma.note: No component set and no doc page of its own: circle/border/cover appear as axes of Card's future set where the sizing system lives. Aspect-ratio classes are variant frame sizes when the Media.vue embed contract lands with the Banner family.

options.name: border
options.description: Inset the image 0.5rem and draw a 1px border in the shared subtle border color.

code.notes: The code prop is shared/media.ts's media_border (consumed by Card and Callout) — deliberately not bound as code.prop: foundations own the CLASSES; the prop gets claimed by the component contracts that spread shared/media.ts when they migrate.

options.name: circle
options.description: Circular crop: forces 1:1 aspect on the img and 50% border-radius on element and img.

code.notes: Reached in code as media_shape='circle' via shared/media.ts — the ONLY media_shape value styled in _media.scss; widescreen/square/no-crop are styled in card.scss and belong to Card's contract. Also applied class-only downstream (blockquote.html.twig).

options.name: cover
options.description: object-fit: cover; img fills its box on both axes.

code.notes: Class-only; no prop emits it in this repo.

options.name: aspectRatio
options.description: iframe aspect-ratio framing for embeds (media--16-9, media--21-9), produced by Media.vue's getAspectRatio.

code.notes: Styled here, but the producing component (Media.vue, embed switcher) has its own deferred contract — these become its option when the Banner-family migration lands. Marked planned so generators don't treat framing as offering embeds.

geometryNotTokenized.circle-radius: 50% border-radius and the forced img aspect-ratio 1 / 1 — shape identity, not scale values
geometryNotTokenized.aspect-ratios: 1/1, 4/3, 16/9, 21/9 iframe ratios — ratios are patterns per tokens/README; in Figma they are variant frame sizes, not variables

behavior: media--border pads the img space/50 (0.5rem) and draws a 1px solid border in color/border/default (consumed directly as var(--uiowa-color-border-default) since the swap; --transparent-border remains the legacy alias other pre-migration code uses)
media--circle zeroes margin-top, sets height auto, and applies aspect-ratio 1/1 + border-radius 50% to the img
media--cover sets object-fit: cover with 100% width and height on the img
knownIssues: media--1-1 and media--4-3 are dead in BOTH repos: Media.vue's getAspectRatio maps only default/ar_16_9/ar_21_9, and no producer exists in uids or uiowa/uiowa (twig/theme/php/config). Public-shape trim deferred to 5.x.
media--default (sizes[0] in shared/media.ts) is styled nowhere — every Card/Callout emits it inertly when media_size='default'.
shared/media.ts argTypes list media_size's default as 'medium' (sizes[2]) but the prop default is 'large' — stale story metadata.

Media.vue type=remote_video/vertical_video renders play/pause controls wired to nothing outside Banner: video.js auto-inits on .media--video (which Media.vue never emits) and hardcodes querySelector('.banner video'). Embed contract deferred to the Banner family for this reason.

Callout.vue spreads ...Media.props into its defineProps but its classes computed never calls Media.addMediaClasses (it calls only Background.addBackgroundClass and Inline.addClass) — media_size/media_shape/media_border are accepted-and-inert on Callout, the Button inert-icon-prop class of issue. Do not read Callout's prop list as functional media options.
